context: M5 o5. Through the luncheonette window, telephoto, Lisle at the counter. Teddy's inner voice.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Tall. Grey suit. Eats like he's being graded.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I know that face. Not from a notice. From a back seat.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Carl's car. Thirty-Fifth Street. Autumn, seventy-one. I waited outside.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: He got in the back with a briefcase. He got out without it.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: H. Lisle, counsel. Okay, counsel. Let's see who you eat with.
